item.title: whoami
item.description: Hi, I’m Ninous! A cybersecurity professional passionate about detection engineering, threat hunting, and breaking things to understand how they work. I started this blog to document my work, research, and thoughts on cybersecurity, with a strong focus on Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Detection Engineering, and Threat Hunting. I work in an MSSP environment as a Sentinel Detection Specialist. I began my career as a Level 1 Analyst, moved up to Level 2, then became a Specialist, and eventually co-founded our Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting department.
